Package org.uma.evolver.util

Class FeasibilityScatterPlot

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.util.FeasibilityScatterPlot
public class FeasibilityScatterPlot extends Object
A scatter plot of some solutions on their first two objectives, those that a criterion accepts in black and the others in red, optionally over a reference front in gray. ConstrainedFrontPlotObserver uses it for the population of an algorithm (feasible or not), and the live plot of a training for the configurations of the meta-optimizer (with or without runs that found no feasible solutions).
